capabilities: Render wikilink citekeys as APA 7 in-text citations
Group adjacent citations into one parenthetical citation
List cited works in a sidebar APA 7 reference list
Open or create literature notes from citations
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.0+), not available on mobile. The README's disclaimer states the code was written by Claude Code from the owner's specification. Reads files outside the vault and makes local-only network calls to Zotero's JSON-RPC endpoint; no telemetry. Known limits: no rendering inside tables/callouts in Live Preview, no frontmatter support, no Pandoc [@key] syntax, APA 7 English (US) only, no citation export.
problem: Obsidian shows citation wikilinks as raw @citekey links instead of formatted in-text citations, breaking academic writing flow.

relations.evidence: reads its bibliography from CSL JSON files that Zotero and Better BibTeX write to a folder on disk
closely inspired by Pandoc Reference List by mgmeyers; no code was copied from it

requires.name: Zotero with the Better BibTeX add-on (needed to export the CSL JSON bibliography; running Zotero is only needed for the reference list's Zotero button)

summary: Renders wikilinks to Better BibTeX citekeys as formatted APA 7 in-text citations in Live Preview and Reading mode, while keeping them clickable vault links.
